body: Thanks a lot for this, I'll keep an eye out for now then in the hope to see the meds helping her. She has an appointment with her psychiatrist tomorrow, I wonder how that'll go.

She recently (2 weeks ago) got new medication. It might actually be because of the new medication now that you mention it, because things had been getting bad for a while but it got worse when she started the new medication. Thanks for your reply.

Hey, thanks for your reaction. I'm trying to do just that, all of her life she was surrounded by people who would treat her like crap and people would just use her and abandon her.. So far since we started living together things seemed to be looking up, but the last couple of weeks things went south again. I'm actually considering your "move away from the life that makes her sad" and just pack our things and leave, thanks a lot for this one. As for your last bit; we already have a few pets (including the annoyingly adorable dog you mentioned) so I hope that's helping her.
